en.summary: This commit fixes a miswired reset on the sqrt subunit inside the FPU DSP wrapper by reconnecting it to the top-level reset instead of div_sqrt_reset.
why_it_counts: It changes active FPU datapath RTL in the instantiated sqrt unit.
Reset connectivity directly affects whether the subunit starts from a known architectural state.
The fix is a precise one-line hardware control correction.
evidence: The fpu_sqrt instance reset port changes from div_sqrt_reset to reset.
In the parent file, div_sqrt_reset has no other local reference, so the old connection was not the normal top-level reset path.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: In a composite arithmetic block that instantiates multiple long-latency subunits, each subunit reset must be driven from the intended global or wrapper-level reset domain. Wiring one subunit to an unrelated internal signal or stray reset net can leave it uninitialized, reset it at the wrong time, or desynchronize it from sibling units.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: System startup, architectural reset, or recovery from reset before the affected arithmetic subunit is used.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Reconnect one arithmetic subunit reset to an unintended internal signal instead of the wrapper's real reset.
portability_notes: Apply this to a wrapper that instantiates separate divide, sqrt, or other multi-cycle arithmetic engines.
The bug does not require changing the subunit internals; only the wrapper port connection needs to be wrong.
It is most likely to appear as startup corruption, stuck state, or inconsistent reset behavior across sibling subunits.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the wrapper that instantiates the long-latency arithmetic subunits.
Find the reset port of one subunit that should follow the wrapper or top-level reset.
Reconnect that reset port to an unrelated local net, a stale internal reset, or another unintended control signal.
Leave the sibling units on the correct reset so the desynchronization is observable.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_fpu_dsp instantiation of the sqrt subunit
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changed the fpu_sqrt reset port from div_sqrt_reset to the wrapper's reset signal.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In hw/rtl/fpu/VX_fpu_dsp.sv, reconnect the fpu_sqrt reset port from reset back to div_sqrt_reset or another unintended local reset net.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: The sqrt unit powers up or recovers with stale internal state, or resets asynchronously relative to the rest of the FPU, causing incorrect sqrt results or bad handshaking after reset.
evidence_for_injection: The only functional change is the reset port connection on the sqrt instance.
The divide instance in the same wrapper already used the normal reset signal.
The old reset name does not participate elsewhere in the local file context.
notes: This fault is particularly clean because it is a wrapper-level wiring mutation.
A reset-oriented test or first use of sqrt after reset should expose it quickly.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 FPU DSP 包装器中 sqrt 子单元的复位连线错误，把它从 div_sqrt_reset 改回顶层 reset。
why_it_counts: 它修改了实际参与执行的 FPU sqrt 子单元 RTL 连接。
复位连线直接决定该子单元是否从已知的体系结构状态启动。
这是一个精确的一行硬件控制修复。
evidence: fpu_sqrt 实例的 reset 端口从 div_sqrt_reset 改成了 reset。
在父版本文件中，div_sqrt_reset 没有其他本地引用，因此旧连线并不是正常的顶层复位路径。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在一个封装多个长延迟算术子单元的复合模块里，每个子单元的 reset 都必须来自预期的全局或包装器级复位域。如果把某个子单元错误地接到无关内部信号或错误的复位网上，它就可能无法正确初始化、在错误时刻复位，或者与其他兄弟子单元失去复位同步。

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 系统上电、体系结构复位，或复位后首次使用受影响的算术子单元时。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把某个算术子单元的 reset 从包装器真实复位改接到一个错误的内部信号。
portability_notes: 可应用在实例化了 div、sqrt 或其他多周期算术引擎的包装器中。
无需修改子单元内部逻辑，只需把包装器端口连错即可。
最常见的外在表现是上电污染、状态卡死，或与其他兄弟子单元的复位行为不一致。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位实例化长延迟算术子单元的包装器模块。
找到其中某个本应跟随包装器或顶层 reset 的子单元 reset 端口。
把该 reset 端口改接到无关的本地网络、陈旧内部 reset，或其他错误控制信号。
保持其他兄弟子单元仍接在正确 reset 上，以便观察复位不同步。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_fpu_dsp 中 sqrt 子单元的实例化连线
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 fpu_sqrt 的 reset 端口从 div_sqrt_reset 改成了包装器的 reset 信号。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 hw/rtl/fpu/VX_fpu_dsp.sv 中，把 fpu_sqrt 的 reset 端口从 reset 改回 div_sqrt_reset 或其他错误的本地复位网络。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: sqrt 单元会带着陈旧内部状态上电或复位恢复，或者与 FPU 其他部分不同步地复位，导致复位后的 sqrt 结果错误或握手异常。
evidence_for_injection: 该提交唯一的功能改动就是 sqrt 实例的 reset 端口连接。
同一包装器中的除法实例已经使用了正常的 reset 信号。
旧的 reset 名称在本地文件上下文中没有其他参与逻辑。
notes: 该故障非常干净，因为它只是包装器级别的连线错误。
带复位序列的测试，或复位后首次使用 sqrt，通常很快就能暴露该问题。
